meta.notes: Source: every bullet product page listed in the sierrabullets.com product sitemap on 2026-11-23. Values come from the manufacturer spec table that each product page embeds as JSON (window.stencilBootstrap "specsJson" and "customFields": Item #, Bullet Type, Bullet Diameter, Bullet Weight (Grains), G1 BC, G7 BC, Bullet Material, Tipped/Non-Tipped); evidence quotes that JSON text verbatim (JS string escaping undone, whitespace collapsed). Sierra's current site publishes ONE G1 and (for some bullets) ONE G7 BC per bullet; it does not publish velocity-banded BCs, bullet length, base-to-ogive, boat-tail length or recommended twist in its spec tables, so those fields are null unless a product description states them (twist, when parsed, is quoted in evidence). The "2026 catalog" offered on https://sierrabullets.com/catalog/ is a single JPEG poster image, not a PDF, and was not used for numbers. construction is mapped from the maker's "Bullet Material" wording ("Jacketed Lead" -> cup-and-core; Bullet Type containing Full Metal Jacket -> FMJ); the raw wording is kept in notes. "firearm" (rifle/handgun) is from the site category the product is listed in. Conflicts list disagreements between the two copies of the spec table on a page, between packaging variants, or between the spec table and the product description text/name. Notes starting with "CHECK:" flag a diameter that differs from other products with the same caliber label (flag only; value kept as published).
